defs.def: the power that sb/sth has to make sb/sth behave in a particular way 支配力；控制力；影响力

ex.s: The modern form of the word — typhoon — was influenced by the Cantonese but  ___40___ to make it appear more Greek.
ex.t: 说明：对于下面文章中的每个空格，有四个标有A、B、C和D的单词或短语。

defs.def: a person or thing that affects the way a person behaves and thinks （对 … ）有影响的人（或事物）

ex.s: No matter how much I had tried to __33__ him, he still influenced me.
ex.t: 不管我曾多么努力想 __33__ 摆脱他他仍然影响着我。

defs.def: to have an effect on the way that sb behaves or thinks, especially by giving them an example to follow 影响；对 … 起作用

ex.s: To test the effect of social influence on eating habits, the researchers conducted two experiments.
